profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA. Its llama.com site presents the company as a platform for AI developers, offering access to its models and tools through the Meta Model API, which the site describes as compatible with existing OpenAI SDK clients. The site highlights several products: Muse Spark, described as a coding-optimized model that writes, reviews, and ships code with lower latency; Muse Code, a coding agent built to run Muse Spark; and Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter open model optimized for local agent workflows and described as small enough to run on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU. The site also notes support for multi-agent workflows, search grounding for live web access, and an OpenAI SDK-compatible API endpoint. Meta's tracked AI product is the Llama open-weight model family, noted as often self-hosted.

Meta reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, per its 10-K filing, and trades publicly under the ticker META with CIK 0001326801. The company faces three active lawsuits in federal court: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the Western District of Texas, Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the Northern District of California, and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc., also in the Northern District of California. Several third-party MCP servers reference Meta's advertising infrastructure, covering campaign management, creative testing, and performance analysis across Facebook and Instagram.
